title: Nanoscale Analysis of SSB-RecO Interplay in SSB Interaction with the Target.
authors: Irukuvajjula, Shivkumar Sharma; Filliaux, Shaun; Lyubchenko, Yuri L
one_liner_zh: 该文通过AFM和分子动力学模拟研究SSB-RecO互作介导的SSB从ssDNA上置换机制，属于广义蛋白质-DNA互作体系，方法含MD模拟，虽非典型TF-DNA但机制建模可迁移借鉴。
abstract: Single-stranded DNA-binding protein (SSB) coats single-stranded DNA (ssDNA) and recruits downstream factors, yet this same coating must be cleared for SSB-interacting proteins to bind. RecA is a central protein in homologous recombination, which requires SSB-free ssDNA to load during the process. RecO, a recombination mediator protein, is thought to regulate this handoff, but it has not been shown directly that RecO drives the release of full-length, ssDNA-bound SSB. Using atomic force microscopy, we show that RecO actively displaces full-length wild-type SSB from a defined ssDNA substrate, reducing occupancy from 67% to 29%. Displacement efficiency decreases after deleting the C-terminal tip of SSB (DeltaC8) or after adding a single alanine at the C-terminus of SSB (A179). Molecular dynamics simulations show that A179 retains its native RecO contact but additionally engages a non-native surface, producing a specific, over-engaged complex, suggesting that these interprotein interactions may affect SSB-ssDNA contacts. Together, these findings suggest that RecO-driven SSB clearance is governed by the protein-protein interface rather than by ssDNA-binding affinity alone, thereby acting as a checkpoint against indiscriminate SSB removal during genome maintenance.
abstract_zh: 单链DNA结合蛋白（SSB）包覆单链DNA（ssDNA）并招募下游因子，然而，这种包覆必须被清除，SSB相互作用蛋白才能结合。RecA是同源重组中的核心蛋白，在该过程中需要无SSB的ssDNA才能装载。RecO，一种重组介导蛋白，被认为调控这一交接过程，但尚未直接证明RecO能驱动全长、ssDNA结合的SSB释放。利用原子力显微镜，我们显示RecO主动将全长野生型SSB从特定ssDNA底物上置换，将占据率从67%降至29%。在删除SSB的C端末端（DeltaC8）或在SSB的C端添加单个丙氨酸（A179）后，置换效率降低。分子动力学模拟显示，A179保留其天然RecO接触，但额外参与非天然表面，形成特异性过度结合复合物，表明这些蛋白间相互作用可能影响SSB-ssDNA接触。综合这些发现表明，RecO驱动的SSB清除受蛋白-蛋白界面调控，而非仅由ssDNA结合亲和力决定，从而在基因组维持过程中充当防止SSB非选择性移除的检查点。
